title: feat(nm2frm1sy): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along -e2 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: -e2 1-step, global tau=1. Reported bits are ('fail','hold') for both reverse and face. Under the per-site cut the reverse pair HOLDs. Recomputed both; the flip is entirely the tau convention.
